title: Trading journey- don’t give up!
author: AutomativeHoneyLove
selftext:
Hi friends, 

I just want to share my automation trading bot journey for those who feel it’s impossible or think they will never be successful.

I been trading for years had payouts, but in process due to emotions lost a lot and no where near successful.

But finally I build a system that takes away the human elements and allows you to make consistent profits on daily basis.

I’ll be posting daily just to give the community reason to believe anything is possible!
